items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I remember Stuff had the band with Cozy and Jonah, and John Brown was on bass

ctx.x: -- gorgeous, gorgeous. I loved playing with him. He -- I called him a pixie. He had a ball wherever he was, whenever, however. I remember Stuff had the band with Cozy and Jonah, and John Brown was on bass, and I forget who the piano player was at the time. And they were at the Green Room at the Edison Hotel.

And Stuff saw a chick pass that had a pretty voluptuous bottom, and he remarked about it. And somebody said, 'I dare you to touch it.' And he touched it with the bow. The band got fired if he didn't leave.

items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: one of the photos he showed me was one from 52nd Street with Coleman Hawkins, Don Bias, Benny Harris, Thelonious Monk, Al Hall and himself.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's right there hanging in my archives.

I'll have to look at that. We were just looking at some more pictures from Cozy's archives, and one of the photos he showed me was one from 52nd Street with Coleman Hawkins, Don Bias, Benny Harris, Thelonious Monk, Al Hall and himself. That's a pretty famous photo. I've seen that in books.
